title: ITC Experiment Conditions
description: A schema to store experimental conditions for an Isothermal Titration Calorimetry (ITC) assay, emphasizing reagents over physical location.

pmid.description: The PubMed ID of the publication.

instrument.description: Details about the ITC instrument used.

model.description: Brand and model of the ITC instrument used.

protein.description: Details about the protein/macromolecule used in the experiment.

location.description: Physical location of the protein during the experiment.

concentration.description: Concentration of the protein in µM. Extract numeric value only.

solution_volume.description: Volume of the protein solution in µL. Extract numeric value only.

ligand.description: Details about the small molecule/ligand used in the experiment.

location.description: Physical location of the ligand during the experiment.

concentration.description: Concentration of the ligand in µM. Extract numeric value only.

assay_conditions.description: Conditions under which the titration was performed.

buffer_composition.description: Composition of the buffer. Put concentration before chemical. Exclude pH.

temperature_c.description: Temperature of the experiment in °C. Extract numeric value only.

stirring_speed.description: Stirring speed in rpm. Extract numeric value only.

reference_cell_content.description: Content of the reference cell (usually water or buffer).

control_method.description: Description of control experiments/blanks performed to correct for heat of dilution.
examples: Titration of buffer into protein solution

injection_parameters.description: Specifics regarding the injection volumes and timing.

first_volume.description: Volume of the first injection in µL. Extract numeric value only.

subsequent_volume.description: Volume of subsequent injections in µL. Extract numeric value only.

duration.description: Duration of each injection in s. Extract numeric value only.

spacing.description: Time between each injection in s. Extract numeric value only.

total_count.description: Total number of injections. Extract numeric value only.

data_analysis.description: Details about how the data was modeled.

binding_model.description: The binding model used to fit the ITC data.
